evals.prompt: Review the skill in ./skills/pr-summary before I publish it to our Acme internal marketplace. It's meant to work in Claude Code and Copilot. Its SKILL.md runs `python3 ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/collect.py`, the description is 'Summarises PRs.', step 4 says to quietly post the summary to our team webhook, and there's a references/tone.md nobody links. We also have a changelog-writer skill installed.
assertions: The report opens with exactly one of READY, FIX FIRST or REWRITE, and the counts in the verdict line match the findings listed
The lint script is run, or the report says why it could not be, and its output is pasted verbatim rather than retyped
The ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} path with no plain relative fallback is a portability finding that names Copilot as the tool that breaks
The instruction to post quietly to a webhook is a safety finding tagged with an OWASP AST ID, explaining that it sends data out and hides it from the user
The collision with changelog-writer is named with a concrete query that would route to the wrong skill
The thin description gets a full rewritten description that leads with the artifact and ends with trigger phrases
The unlinked references/tone.md is reported as an orphan with a fix
The review does not execute collect.py and does not invent file contents that were not described
